# telnyx_siprec_connector (Resource)

A SIPREC connector, which sends call media to a SIP recording server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_siprec_connector" "example" {
  name = "compliance-recorder"
  host = "srs.example.com"
  port = 5060
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Hostname/IPv4 address of the SIPREC SRS.
- `name` (String) Name for the SIPREC connector resource.
- `port` (Number) Port for the SIPREC SRS.

### Optional

- `app_subdomain` (String) Subdomain to route calls when using Telnyx SRS (optional).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date/time of creation.
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date/time of last update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_siprec_connector.example <name>
```
